```json
{"tests": [{"name": "Empty name", "given": "name = \"\"", "expect": "Hello, World!", "polarity": "success", "covers": "happy"}, {"name": "Single name", "given": "name = \"Ada\"", "expect": "Hello, Ada!", "polarity": "success", "covers": "happy"}, {"name": "Whitespace name", "given": "name = \" \"", "expect": "Hello,  !", "polarity": "success", "covers": "input:name"}, {"name": "Long name", "given": "name = \"VeryLongName\"", "expect": "Hello, VeryLongName!", "polarity": "success", "covers": "input:name"}]}
```

```go
package greet_test

import (
	"hello/internal/greet"
	"testing"
)

func TestFormatGreeting(t *testing.T) {
	tests := []struct {
		name     string
		nameIn   string
		wantOut  string
	}{
		{
			name:    "Empty name",
			nameIn:  "",
			wantOut: "Hello, World!",
		},
		{
			name:    "Single name",
			nameIn:  "Ada",
			wantOut: "Hello, Ada!",
		},
		{
			name:    "Whitespace name",
			nameIn:  " ",
			wantOut: "Hello,  !",
		},
		{
			name:    "Long name",
			nameIn:  "VeryLongName",
			wantOut: "Hello, VeryLongName!",
		},
	}

	for _, tt := range tests {
		t.Run(tt.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			got := greet.FormatGreeting(tt.nameIn)
			if got != tt.wantOut {
				t.Errorf("FormatGreeting(%q) = %q; want %q", tt.nameIn, got, tt.wantOut)
			}
		})
	}
}

func BenchmarkFormatGreeting(b *testing.B) {
	for i := 0; i < b.N; i++ {
		greet.FormatGreeting("Ada")
	}
}
```
